newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL TO ANNOUNCE JULY FEDERAL TAX RECEIPTS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL TO ANNOUNCE JULY FEDERAL TAX RECEIPTS.

text.p: Brazil's Internal Revenue Service will announce tax receipts for July at 1500 local/1400 EDT/1800 GMT, a spokeswoman said.
Federal tax receipts in June reached 8.599 billion reais, 10.38 percent higher in real terms than the 7.79 billion reais collected in the same month a year ago.
First half tax revenue amounted to 53.571 billion reais, a 5.99 percent increase in real terms over the first half of 1996.
